display.purpose: Hero headlines, property names, editorial moments.

title.purpose: Card titles, UI subheads via Lexend.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main conversion CTA: book stay, checkout confirm.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background: #001F3F; color: #F6F7ED; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.95; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DBE64C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Light Button
components.description: Secondary action on dark or photo backgrounds.
components.css: .ds-btn-light { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid rgba(246, 247, 237, 0.7); border-radius: 9999px; padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background: rgba(246, 247, 237, 0.9); color: #001F3F; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-light:hover { background: #FFFFFF; } .ds-btn-light:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DBE64C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Book Input
components.description: Booking bar date and guest fields.
components.html: <input class="ds-book-input" type="text" placeholder="Check-in date" aria-label="Check-in date" />
components.css: .ds-book-input { width: 100%; height: 48px; border-radius: 1rem; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.15); background: rgba(246, 247, 237, 0.85); padding: 0 16px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #001F3F; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-book-input::placeholder { color: #3A4F66; } .ds-book-input:focus-visible { border-color: #DBE64C; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(219, 230, 76, 0.25); }

components.name: Quiet Card
components.description: Elevated content container with soft editorial shadow.
components.html:
Rosewood

Boutique comfort on Rajpur Road with rooftop views.
components.css: .ds-quiet-card { border-radius: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.12); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.06); } .ds-quiet-card-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #001F3F; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-quiet-card-body { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.75; color: #3A4F66; margin: 0; }

components.name: Tier Pill Essential
components.description: Property tier badge for Essential tier.
components.css: .ds-tier-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(110, 170, 90, 0.4); background: rgba(110, 170, 90, 0.12); padding: 4px 12px; font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: hsl(110, 38%, 48%); }

components.name: Site Link
components.css: .ds-site-link { font-family: Inter, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.01em; color: rgba(0, 31, 63, 0.8); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-site-link:hover { color: #001F3F; } .ds-site-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #DBE64C; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Zenvana's visual system is editorial hospitality for the Himalayan foothills: serif display type, sand-and-ink neutrals, photography-forward layouts, and restrained accent color. It reads like an Indian boutique hotel that trusts its guests to notice quality without being sold to.
keyCharacteristics: Serif editorial display (Fraunces) paired with Inter body
Sand background with midnight ink text; spring green accent used sparingly
Pill-shaped CTAs, large corner radii, soft editorial shadows
Photography-first heroes with mandatory contrast scrims

rules.name: The Scrim Rule
rules.body: Text over photography must always sit on a scrim or overlay that guarantees WCAG AA contrast.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Spring green and editorial gold combined occupy ≤15% of any viewport.

rules.name: The Weight Rule
rules.body: Body copy never uses font-weight below 400.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows appear as a response to state, not as permanent decoration.

dos: Do use Fraunces for display headlines and Inter for body
Do apply hero scrims whenever type sits over photography
Do lazy-load images and respect variable bandwidth on Indian mobile
Do provide full keyboard and screen-reader paths through booking checkout
Do degrade all motion under prefers-reduced-motion
donts: Don't use OTA-style price-first grids or impersonal listing cards
Don't ship SaaS template patterns: gradient heroes, metric blocks, identical icon-card grids
Don't use luxury cliché: gold gradient text, thin gray type over photos
Don't add eyebrow kickers above every section or numbered scaffolding without purpose
Don't use side-stripe borders on cards or alerts
Don't gate content visibility on animation classes
